text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
*Yawn*... It seems another sleepy fairy 
has come to visit me...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I was having a rendezvous with the 
full moon all night, you see.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Drawn in by the faint, pristine white glow 
filtering through, I realized what had 
happened the moment I opened the window.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
She thought a lonely, sorrowful soul who 
could only see me once a month had come to 
visit...!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
For that full moon, I stayed up recounting 
the heroic tales of the "Supreme Overlord" 
until dawn broke.

Seeing how sleepy T.M. Opera O was, we 
wrapped up the meeting early.
